alander-2025.title: Comparing Microphones Used in Medical Dictation Based on Speech Recognition Accuracy and Usability
alander-2025.statistic: mean WER, average of stages 1 and 2 (Table 9)
alander-2025.setup: Close-up dictation in quiet; 60 cm laptop, 6.5 cm handhelds, 3 cm headsets in playback tests
alander-2025.limits: Two speakers in stage 1, six in stage 2; stage 2 replayed SpeechOne recordings through a Bose SoundLink Mini; distance not tested. Thesis is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; only numeric results are cited here.

bradford-2022.authors: Mariah Bradford, Paige Hansen, Ross Beveridge, Nikhil Krishnaswamy, Nathaniel Blanchard
bradford-2022.title: A deep dive into microphone hardware for recording collaborative group work
bradford-2022.setup: 33 people in 11 groups, simultaneous recording, mics 5 ft away
bradford-2022.limits: One ASR engine; differences within one SD; Blue Yeti used in omni mode. Authors' overall pick was the MXL AC-404, for noise robustness and price.

tran-2026.authors: Brian D. Tran, Di Hu, Seungjun Kim, Yawen Guo, Ramya Mangu, Tera L. Reynolds, Jennifer Elston Lafata, Ming Tai-Seale, Kai Zheng
tran-2026.title: Does Recording Hardware Matter for Clinical Speech Recognition? Evaluating ASR Performance Across Consumer Devices
tran-2026.engine: Azure Whisper (one of six engines tested)
tran-2026.setup: 35 re-enacted clinical conversations, simultaneous recording, about 1.5 ft; clip-on worn by one speaker; quiet
tran-2026.limits: Two speakers. Across engines, pooled medians ranged 16.7-20.7%.

tipaksorn-2025.title: LOTUSDIS: A Thai far-field meeting corpus for robust conversational ASR
tipaksorn-2025.setup: Spontaneous three-person Thai meetings with overlapping speech
tipaksorn-2025.limits: Device and distance change together; not a dictation task.

rosehill-2025.title: One-Shot Transcription Microphone Eval
rosehill-2025.setup: One speaker, one 315-word passage, mostly a quiet home office
rosehill-2025.limits: One take per condition; one word is 0.32 points, so the 4.13-6.35% spread is about seven words. An anecdotal data point, not a ranking.
